entries.speaker: Thin-Browed Student
entries.en: Finally, I'm finished. Now I can go to[n]Shibuya with my boyfriend.

entries.speaker: Duck-Faced Student
entries.en: Oh, be careful. I heard there's a lot of[n]muggings targeting couples lately.

entries.speaker: Thin-Browed Student
entries.en: Wha—? I should be fine, right? The police[n]will do something about it.

entries.speaker: Duck-Faced Student
entries.en: Yeah. Maybe I'll stop by somewhere fun on[n]the way home, too. I don't care about[n]college exams, anyway.

entries.speaker: Glaring Third-Year
entries.en: Did you see that second-year on the[n]volleyball team? He must've taken a[n]spike in the face.

entries.speaker: Assertive Volleyball Player
entries.en: Oh, Mishima, right? He's a real slowpoke,[n]so I'm not surprised.

entries.speaker: Assertive Volleyball Player
entries.en: It's frustrating to watch. He's not getting[n]much better, even with Mr. Kamoshida's[n]coaching.

entries.speaker: Glaring Third-Year
entries.en: Oh, I hear Kamoshida was invited by[n]the national championships? That's[n]pretty amazing.

entries.speaker: Glaring Third-Year
entries.en: He's definitely going to be the MVP at our[n]school's volleyball rally tomorrow.
Is it true that he murdered someone?[n]Why is he coming to our school?
The volleyball rally's still going on[n]tomorrow too, right? What a drag.
He has a criminal record, right? His life's[n]pretty much ruined.
Mr. Kamoshida is too good. How is that fair[n]for the other teams?
Hey, look at him... He's such an eyesore.[n]I wish he'd go away already.
